'''2016 MPC Erik Winings DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Erik Winings]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Erik Winings]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 1
